messages:
Maya (Finance): Heads up — month-end bill run flagged a ~$48,200 mismatch in deferred revenue for March. Affected invoices INV-76612, INV-76613 and a handful of trial accounts. Looks like promo credit got applied twice during the pricing experiment. tagging @Omar @Kai :eyes:
Omar (Billing): saw the alert. billing-job `monthly/invoice-run/2024-03` retried at 03:12 and I see duplicate credit lines for the 'trial-pricing-experiment' cohort in the invoice payloads.
Lina (RevOps): ugh. can you paste the raw lines or query so we can quantify impact for the close pack? need $ impact by customer and whether it's deferrable.
Omar (Billing): here's the snippet from the invoice db export:
```
invoice_id,account_id,charge_type,amount,line_note
INV-76612,acct_991,credit,-1200,"promo:trial-pricing-experiment"
INV-76612,acct_991,credit,-1200,"promo:trial-pricing-experiment"
INV-76613,acct_992,credit,-800,"promo:trial-pricing-experiment"
```
Omar (Billing): looks like an idempotency key was missing in the retry path — the first run created the credits, retry created them again.
Kai (SRE Billing): confirmed. retry handler `billing/consumer/retry_wrapper` didn't set idempotency for `promo_apply` when experiment flag present. PR incoming, will patch to check idempotency_key before insert.
Raj (Accounting): we need a proposed adjusting entry for month close. If revenue was overstated, we'd reverse recognized revenue into deferred for the $48.2k? Lina — confirm whether these are recognized revenue items or pure discounts reducing billed revenue.
Lina (RevOps): most of these promos were applied at invoice line level post-recognition for committed custs; for trials they reduce billed revenue. For month close, treat as deduction from revenue (i.e., increase deferred/contra as needed). I'll send a mapping.
Elise (SalesOps): FYI some customers already saw credit memos. Don’t want to double-credit in CX. If we backfill fixes, coordinate credit memos vs corrected invoices.
Maya (Finance): action items I propose:
- Omar/Kai: patch + backfill plan and CSV of corrected invoice lines (by EOD)
- Omar: run backfill in staging and generate migration diff (which rows to delete/insert)
- Lina: quantify per-customer impact and tag which are deferrable vs immediate revenue adjustments
- Raj: prepare reversing JE template for review (use GL 4001/2300 mapping)
- Elise: flag any customer comms that would be required if we reissue credits

billing-bot: billing-job runtime alert: invoice-run (2024-03) retried=1 duplicates=34 total_dup_amount=48200

Omar (Billing): posting CSV to /shared/finance/billing_fix_2048765432.csv now. Will include primary_key, invoice_id, account_id, original_line_id, duplicate_line_id.
Kai (SRE Billing): patch merged to main, deploy rolling now. Should prevent further dupes. Will re-run the idempotency check script across SQS consumers.
Raj (Accounting): draft JE for review: "Dr Sales Revenue 48,200; Cr Deferred Revenue 48,200" — tagging @Maya for signoff. We'll post as a reconciling accrual if the backfill completes before close, otherwise post accrual and reverse next month.
Maya (Finance): sign off on that JE for accrual approach. Please include memo: 'duplicate promo credit application from billing retry; reversing recognized revenue to deferred; supports month-end recon.'
Lina (RevOps): uploaded impact spreadsheet to the close pack and marked each row with 'deferrable' or 'credit memo issued'.
Elise (SalesOps): coordinating on customer comms for 6 impacted customers who already saw visible credits. We'll only reissue if necessary; otherwise we'll net on next invoice.
Omar (Billing): once backfill runs I'll produce before/after invoice exports and a verification script. Expect to complete backfill + verification in ~6 hours.
Kai (SRE Billing): re-run completed in staging, backfill script dry-run looks clean. Schedule production backfill at 02:00 UTC to avoid race with billing windows.
Raj (Accounting): if production backfill finishes before COB tomorrow we will adjust rev schedules and avoid manual accrual. If not, we'll post the accrual as drafted and reverse after backfill.
Maya (Finance): thanks team. please update the close tracker and ping me when the backfill CSV is ready for accounting. target: close pack updated by COB tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Omar (Billing): will post final run report to the channel when done.
Elise (SalesOps): noted — prepping one-liner for customers if we need it.
Maya (Finance): closing loop — mark item as 'in-flight' in month-close and add to recon list.
